services.name: Kids Camp
services.desc: Karate camp for kids is much more than karate. Social Games, Bully Prevention, Fitness, Goal Setting, and Outdoor Activities. Each week is a different theme, all our martial arts training, games, arts, and crafts will be based on the theme of the week. Such as Ninja Turtles, Dragons, Avatar, Minecraft, Ninjas, Tigers, and The Karate Kid. Through games and training together children will further develop their ability to understand the emotions and behaviours of others, and to respond accordingly. Ability to compromise and listen.
